durability.boundary: Only the last completed atomic durable write is guaranteed after abrupt termination. Timer scheduling and filesystem latency are not hard bounded. Orderly exit flushes and refuses to leave after a reported write failure.

not_measured: Universal maximum uncommitted keystroke window under arbitrary storage stalls
